best_idea: Route every hit and move sound through a latest-wins throttle (one sound per window, the last waiting call wins), but give kill and death cues their own lane so a routine hit can never replace them.
decision_why: Take the 100 ms latest-wins window and a separate priority lane for kill and death, which keeps dense many-on-one fights readable; reject the donor's speech-mode and cross-tab rules, which do not fit Frankendom.
acceptance: In a three-on-one fight, one hit sound plays per 100 ms at most, and a kill or death sting plays within one window even while hits are landing; a client test drives twenty hits and one kill inside a single window and asserts the kill sting is among the played cues.
